slides.headline: THESE 3 MEN ARE WORTH $700 BILLION COMBINED. EVERY BIG DECISION THEY MAKE STARTS WITH THE SAME 5 QUESTIONS
1) CUT EVERY STEP YOUR BUSINESS DOESN'T NEED
slides.body: Musk tests every Tesla production step this way. "Here is my business process: [describe it]. Go through every step. If removing it changes nothing, delete it permanently"

slides.headline: 2) KILL YOUR 20 BIGGEST DISTRACTIONS
slides.body: Buffett told his pilot: list 25 goals, never touch anything outside the top 5. "Here are my priorities: [list]. Pick the 5 worth keeping. Tell me why the others are traps"

slides.headline: 3) ASK YOUR 80-YEAR-OLD SELF WHAT TO DO
slides.body: Bezos quit a Wall Street job at 30 using this exact question. "I'm deciding whether to [decision]. Imagine I'm 80 looking back. Which choice would I regret more and why?"

slides.headline: 4) FIND EVERY WAY YOUR BUSINESS COULD DIE
slides.body: Munger built Berkshire Hathaway by always asking what could kill it first. "Don't tell me how to grow. List every way my business fails in 12 months, ranked. Flip each into a fix"

slides.headline: 5) TURN YOUR WORST MISTAKE INTO A RULE
slides.body: Dalio built Bridgewater into the world's biggest fund using one habit: a written rule for every mistake. "I keep making this mistake: [describe]. Turn it into a clear if-then rule I follow every time"

slides.headline: SAVE THESE BEFORE YOUR NEXT BIG DECISION
slides.body: You'll want these prompts when you need them most. Daily AI news and real skills at @yaffeai
